Mi sheBerakh (a protective prayer) for those documenting the atrocities of 7 October 2023

tei:bibl.tei:title: מי שברך לעוסקות ועוסקים במלאכת תיעוד הפגיעות המיניות ומעשי הקינוסייד ב 7.10
Mi sheBerakh (a protective prayer) for those documenting the atrocities of 7 October 2023
tei:bibl.tei:author: Gila Caine
tei:bibl.tei:note: Converted from the export of opensiddur.org at 624215eef0.

tei:div.tei:p: I had the honour of hearing Dr. Cochav Elkayam Levy speak of the work she has done since Oct. 7, 2023, documenting the savagery committed by Hamas on that day. Apart from documenting the torture, rape and murder committed that day, Dr. Elkayam-Levy and her team named a specific form of terror: Kinocide—violently harming family members in each other’s presence. After her talk, I realized our community must support both this work and those doing it. Exposure to such evidence is itself harmful (which is why Hamas livestreamed their attacks), making this documentation both sacred work and a source of spiritual, mental, and emotional trauma. The Mi Sheberakh I wrote is one step toward creating a community of protection around those doing this unbearably difficult work. Read more about this on my page.
This mi sheberakh prayer was offered by Rabbi Gila Caine for those reviewing and compiling the documentary evidence of the depraved violence committed by HAMA”S and its allies on 7 October 2023.
